drafts.angle: One-shot creative still needs a gate (rides @karpathy TristanTube in 3 minutes)
drafts.draft_en:
Karpathy one-shotted a 47K-video app in 3 minutes.

Your marketing team can now one-shot 50 ad variants before lunch.

The build step is gone. The review step is not.

Every one of those ads still has to clear brand rules, legal claims, and platform policy.

Aubric is the 3-minute review: approve, fix, or block before a dollar of spend.
drafts.video_tip: 20s screen recording: timer in the corner counts 3:00 while an agent spits out 50 ad variants, then every variant streams through Aubric and lands in APPROVE, FIX, or BLOCK buckets. End card: 'Built in 3 minutes. Cleared in 3 minutes.'

drafts.angle: Learn to market, then learn to clear (rides @gregisenberg 'learn to market is the new learn to code')
drafts.draft_en:
Learn to market is the new learn to code.

Learn to clear is the new learn to market.

Anyone can generate the ad now. Very few teams can prove it's on-brand, legally safe, and compliant with Meta, TikTok, and Google policy before it runs.

That's the job we built Aubric for.
drafts.video_tip: 15s vertical, three title cards in a row: 'learn to code' crossed out, 'learn to market' crossed out, 'learn to clear' with an Aubric APPROVE stamp. Keep it text-only on black, Hormozi-style pacing, one line per beat.

drafts.angle: Find / build / clear playbook for AI ads (rides @gregisenberg iOS-with-agents list format)
drafts.draft_en:
Here's how I'd ship AI ads with agents in 2026:

find it
- pull your top 10 ads by ROAS
- note the hook, offer, and format of each

build it
- have an agent generate 30 variants per winner
- keep the same offer, change the hook

clear it
- run every variant through brand, legal, and platform checks
- fix what's fixable, block the rest

ship it
- launch only what cleared

Step 3 is where most teams blow up their ad account. It's the step we automate at Aubric.
drafts.video_tip: 30s talking-head with on-screen checklist that ticks off find / build / clear / ship. Slow down on 'clear it' and cut to a 5-second Aubric screen showing a variant flagged for an unapproved claim and auto-fixed. Save-worthy list formats earn bookmarks, so caption 'save this for your next launch.'
